decision.summary: A confirmed temporary vertical offset occurs in U (indices 608–613), with coherent opposing E-dip and neutral N, satisfying onset–sustained–return criteria. A subsequent short platform (614–615) lacks definitive return evidence and is marked uncertain. No other temporary offsets within allowed context [570,650] meet full criteria.

intervals.observation: U-component shows abrupt drop (~3 MAD) starting at index 608, sustained through 609–610, with clear recovery beginning at 611 and returning to pre-event baseline by index 613; E-component exhibits smaller opposing dip (negative) during same window, N remains neutral. Return is observed and coherent across axes.

U-component remains slightly elevated above immediate post-drop level (a subtle platform) from 614 to 615; however, the return to long-term trend is ambiguous—no clear opposing motion or re-stabilization beyond index 613, and no further data confirms full restoration. Cross-axis signals are quiet here, suggesting residual uncertainty in whether this is part of the same transient or a separate slow adjustment.
